page_title: ACM 1-2 INT | AC Milan v Inter 22/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) can have an early bath after being sent off by the referee for a tackle that simply has no place in football!
90+7' AC Milan fail to score from a corner as Yann Sommer (Inter) leaps to collect the ball.
90+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AC Milan comes to nothing.
90+4' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) can have an early bath after being sent off by the referee for a tackle that simply has no place in football!
90+4' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is awarded a red card due to his behaviour.
90+2' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) for a tough tackle.
88' Simone Inzaghi appears to have said too much and referee Andrea Colombo comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
88' Here is a change. Alessandro Bastoni is going off and Simone Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Stefan de Vrij (Inter).
84' Matteo Darmian comes off the pitch to be replaced by Denzel Dumfries (Inter).
84' Here's the change. Hakan Calhanoglu leaves the pitch and Kristjan Asllani (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
81' Andrea Colombo sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
81' Wait! Referee Andrea Colombo has indicated he is going to review the AC Milan goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
80' 1 - 2 Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the bottom right corner, and thus alter the score to 1:2.
80' What a save from Yann Sommer! Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
79' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
79' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yann Sommer intercepts the ball.
78' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Federico Dimarco will be replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
77' Substitution. Noah Okafor (AC Milan) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Yunus Musah walks off.
77' Substitution. Nicolo Barella makes way for Davide Frattesi (Inter).
77' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
76' Andrea Colombo interrupts the game. One of the players from Inter won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.

75' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.

74' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
73' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
72' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
68' That's the end of the game for Yacine Adli, who is replaced by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan).
68' It will be a substitution. Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) is ready to enter the pitch as Ruben Loftus-Cheek walks off.
67' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Federico Dimarco (Inter) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
66' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
65' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle. Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) commits a foul after dangerous play. It's a free kick to Inter, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

62' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
61' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) is penalised for holding. Andrea Colombo signals a set piece. Inter will take a free kick near the side line.
59' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
58' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
58' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
57' Marcus Thuram (Inter) is penalised for a foul. Andrea Colombo had a clear view and blows his whistle. AC Milan are awarded the free kick.
56' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
56' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Yunus Musah (AC Milan). AC Milan win a corner.
55' Inter concede a free kick following a bad challenge. It's a free kick to AC Milan, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
52' Substitution. Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) in, Tijjani Reijnders out.
52' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Yann Sommer makes a smart save to deny him.
51' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

49' 0 - 2 Marcus Thuram (Inter) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Mike Maignan is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:2.
49' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Andrea Colombo has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
42' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
40' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the middle of the goal, but Mike Maignan keeps it out with an amazing save.
40' Marcus Thuram (Inter) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
39' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) produces a good strike that sails towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
38' Marcus Thuram (Inter) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
37' Federico Dimarco (Inter) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.
37' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Theo Hernandez (AC Milan), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
33' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Yunus Musah (AC Milan) who loops his header high over the bar.
32' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Andrea Colombo didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
32' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
29' What a sweet touch by Rafael Leao (AC Milan) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Yann Sommer to hold.
29' Matteo Darmian (Inter) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
27' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
26' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) commits a foul and Andrea Colombo immediately signals a free kick.

25' Ambitious effort from Lautaro Martinez (Inter). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
23' Rough tackle by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Inter have a free kick.
22' Today's referee Andrea Colombo rightly decides to book Nicolo Barella (Inter) for his harsh tackle.
22' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the mid-range free kick and sends it towards the roof of the net, but he is denied by the goalkeeper.
22' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Inter will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
20' A player from AC Milan commits a rough challenge. Andrea Colombo blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Inter are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
18' 0 - 1 Francesco Acerbi (Inter) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the bottom right corner. The score is 0:1.
18' The ball goes out for a corner. Inter can continue in their attacking effort.

17' Marcus Thuram (Inter) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Inter.
17' Matteo Darmian (Inter) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
16' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
15' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
10' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
8' Andrea Colombo interrupts the game. One of the players from AC Milan won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Inter win a free kick.
8' What a big chance! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
4' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' The first half has started.
AC Milan will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Andrea Colombo.
